title: Kanban
summary: The board layout of the view set: lanes by one field, cards with up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, a move is a change of that field the host settles. sf-view layout="board" draws it over the lane window.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

size.description: The rung of the lane heads, the cards and their controls.

title-field.description: The record key a card's title reads (else title, name, id).

order-field.description: The source's manual order field (describe().order_field). Without it a lane follows the view's sort (C304 (2)).

sort-active.description: A sort is on in the view: manual reorder inside a lane is off (C304 (2)).

selectable.description: Cards carry the selection box; Space marks a card.

creatable.description: «+» in a lane head and «Новая запись» in the lane menu: the create event with the lane's value.

movable.description: Moves are offered; false refuses each with «Нет права менять».

sums-pending.description: The sum line of each lane head is held empty until setLaneTotals brings the sums: for a page that computes them after the cards. sf-view does not set it: the sums come with the cards (C304).

lanes.description: The lane window the host answered (C304): the first per_lane records of every lane, each lane's total under the filter and its sums (C294), a cursor for «Показать ещё».

fields.description: Field descriptors (sf-view's columns): the lane field's options give the lane order, labels and colours; the card fields are drawn by the Framework field renderers.

options.description: layouts.board of simai.view-config/1: lane_field, lanes {order, hidden, collapsed}, empty_lanes show|hide, card_fields (up to four), totals (count, {sum: key}), limits {lane: n} (soft, C304 (3)), order sort|manual, per_lane (20), swimlane_field (reserved, C304 (4)).

moves.description: The host's move rules: {<to>: {from: [...], reason}}; a lane that refuses dims with the reason while a card is held and is disabled in «Переместить в».

actions.description: The host's actions on a selection, after «Переместить в…».

lane.const: {value, label?, total, totals: {<field>: {<currency>: amount}}, records: [...], cursor}

settleMove.summary: The host's answer to a move: {answer: applied, record?} keeps it; refused or conflict ({reason, message}) puts the card back and says why.

appendLane.summary: The host's next records of one lane (the answer to more).

setLaneTotals.summary: The lanes' totals the host answered after the cards ([{value, totals}], sums per currency); cards and cursors stay.

sf-view-board-move.summary: A card moved (drag, keys, the card menu, the bulk bar): shown at once and pale until the host answers settleMove. Cancel to refuse at once.

sf-view-board-open.summary: The card's title or «Открыть» in its menu (vocabulary open): the host opens the record card (sf-view-properties, C289).

sf-view-board-create.summary: «+» in a lane: the host opens a new record with the lane's value.

sf-view-board-more.summary: «Показать ещё» in a lane: the host answers appendLane with that lane's next records.

sf-view-board-save.summary: A lane folded, unfolded or hidden: the board's options to keep in the view (layouts.board.lanes).

sf-view-board-apply.summary: A host action chosen on the selection in the bulk bar.

untrusted_inputs: lane labels, titles and field values (drawn as text or by the field renderers)

accessibility.focus: A region named by aria-label (else «Канбан»); one Tab stop for the board, the arrows inside (lanes left and right, a lane's head, cards and «Показать ещё» up and down); a polite live region says every move and refusal; after a settled move focus stays on the card.

changes: New: the board layout (owner decisions C298, C304): lanes by one field from the host's lane window, cards with up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, moves as a change of the lane field the host settles (settleMove), «Показать ещё» per lane (appendLane), soft limits, folded and hidden lanes, one lane per screen on a phone, one Tab stop with the arrows inside.

Lane sums after the cards (view round 2 merge, agreed with Larena): sums-pending (set by sf-view while it asks the sums in a second request) holds the sum line of every lane head, so nothing grows when they come; setLaneTotals([{value, totals}]) merges the answered totals into the lanes without touching their cards or cursors.

The sums-pending description: sf-view asks the lane totals with the cards in one request (C304, VR2-9) and no longer sets it; the attribute and setLaneTotals stay for a page that computes the sums later.

DEV's open item B1 (round/view-r5): the column head's buttons (.sf-view-board__row, .sf-view-board__top) are --sf-space-1/3 apart (8; 4 compact), the gap of buttons of one group (H5), not --sf-space-1/4 (4).
View round 9 (round/view-r9): rule.js and component.json relations name cl-bulk-actions (lazy), composition.uses smart.bulk-actions; the pair's field-renderers provenance hash.
View round 12, set 3 (DEV msg-c31ccebd, VHF-10): js/templates/default.css .sf-view-board[data-size="1"] .sf-view-board__title, .sf-view-board__fields take --sf-text-size-1 and --sf-text-height-1.
View round 12, owner decision D2 (DEV msg-4de06ae6): lang title and board-label «Канбан» / «Kanban»; component.json and smart.manifest.json focus note.

View modular step 1 (round/view-modular-1): takes its shared code (the Framework field renderers, formats, conditions and filter window, and what two View components share) from the package core smart/view-common once per page, instead of a copy in its own bundle; relation cl-view-common.
LV3-16 box and «⋯» on the title's first line
RV4-11 title and fields share one start
View round 15m: round/view-r14 and round/view-modular-1 joined into one line (merge, no rebase); the number is above both branches.
View round 17: repin on SIMAI Framework pair ui-b4f79e1c58b7 (ui-source e59dbad1c108, core.runtime 1.67.0); provenance of src/smart/field-renderers/index.js.

View round 18: laneChoices, showLane, _unhidden over the options' hidden lanes, words hidden-text / hide-hint name «Вид», new word shown-text; the ResizeObserver callback measures on the next frame (_measureFrame).

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-board through sf-view layout="board" for records grouped by a status, choice, user or yes/no field, where a person moves them between lanes.
do_not: Do not save a move in the element; answer sf-view-board-move and call settleMove.
Do not use it for a calendar or a timeline.
